environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs as terraform-provider-diskalloc_v1.2.0 on an Ubuntu 22.04 host with no MAC enforcement. The provider process runs under the 'terraform' user which has write access to /etc, /var, and the workspace directory. SELinux is in permissive mode (effectively disabled). No AppArmor profiles are loaded for the provider binary.

config.apparmor_status: no profile loaded for provider binary
